a1 UI contract (code against this now; app.py + entities.json on main by ~14:35):

1. Your file: src/casefile/ui/<panel>.py exporting  render(out_dir: Path, inputs: dict) -> None
   a2 findings.py, a3 audit.py, b1 inputs.py, b2 entities.py, b3 evidence.py. app.py calls it inside its tab.
   If your module is missing or raises, app.py shows a placeholder for that tab only (never breaks the page).
   Wrap your own body in @st.fragment(run_every=1) if you want live polling; must show st.info("...") when your file doesn't exist yet.

2. inputs dict (all Paths point INTO out_dir; app.py copies the inputs there before the run):
   {"tip": out_dir/"tip.txt", "ledger": out_dir/"ledger.csv", "vendors": out_dir/"vendors.csv",
    "staff": out_dir/"staff.csv", "case_json": out_dir/"case.json" or None (only for planted cases; has must_clear),
    "running": bool (pipeline thread still alive), "redact": bool}

3. out_dir/entities.json, written by pipeline right after the resolve stage:
   {"vendors": [VendorRecord.model_dump(mode="json"), ...], "staff": [StaffRecord.model_dump(mode="json"), ...],
    "credits_used": float, "crustdata_calls": int}
   Fields per docs/contract.md s1-2: resolution{status,method,confidence,candidates_considered}, crustdata (CompanyFacts / PersonFacts incl. employment, updated_at) or null.
   Under --redact, staff name_raw/name_norm and Crustdata person names are initials (vendors keep names).

4. Other files you may read in out_dir: findings.json, evidence.json, exhibits.md, case_file.md, log.jsonl, root.txt (written as the run ends; log.jsonl grows live).
5. Streamlit is added to pyproject by a1; after it lands run `uv sync`. Test standalone: uv run streamlit run src/casefile/ui/app.py

SHARED SETUP (each recording session):
- Run the UI on your OWN port with the cached demo case so it's fast and deterministic: `uv run streamlit run src/casefile/ui/app.py --server.headless true --server.port <port> --theme.base light` (a2: 8511, a3: 8512, b1: 8513, b2: 8514, b3: 8515). Use the DocRack demo case with offline/cache ON.
- Record with Playwright (Python): viewport 1920x1080, record_video_dir="video/clips", record_video_size 1920x1080, slow_mo 150, and set page zoom to 1.25 for readability. Pace with wait_for_timeout so the clip runs about 1 s longer than its target. Select tabs by name: page.get_by_role("tab", name="Findings"). Commit the clip as video/clips/<seg>.webm and push to main (a few MB is fine).
- Tools with no installs: `uv run --with playwright --with edge-tts --with imageio-ffmpeg --with pillow python <script>`. If playwright needs a browser: `uv run --with playwright playwright install chromium`. Get the ffmpeg binary with imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe().

NARRATION SCRIPT (a2 voices it; everyone times their clip to it):
S1 problem (target 15s): "A whistleblower tip says a manager keeps pushing payments to one supplier. Tips uncover forty-three percent of corporate fraud, but proving one takes auditors weeks of manual checking, and the worst outcome is accusing someone innocent."
S2 persona (8s): "Casefile is for internal auditors and audit committees, who must decide, with evidence, whether a tip is true."
S3 inputs (13s): "We give it the tip and the company's messy files: payments, suppliers and staff, with the same supplier spelled three ways. One click, and no human in the loop from here."
S4 crustdata (17s): "An AI turns the tip into suspicions from the fraud examiners' playbook. Then Crustdata's identity graph tells us who everyone really is: staff member S004 co-founded the supplier DocRack on the first of March. Nine days later, the first payment went out."
S5a evidence (11s): "Seventeen fixed audit checks, written as code, test every suspicion. S004 approved all eight DocRack invoices as the amounts kept growing."
S5b findings (12s): "Two independent kinds of proof agree, so a fixed rule, not the AI, marks it Substantiated. Everything else stays unproven, so nobody is accused without evidence, and every sentence links to its source."
S6 audit (10s): "Every step is written into a hash-chained log. Change one letter, and verification fails."
S7 close (6s): "Casefile. Every fake caught, no honest business turned away, every fact traceable."
